title: Trace: watch demand travel upstream

checklist.step: Pull and test only through the last requested match
Show the real pulled prefix and outputs at every event

hints: Demand for one output may require examining rejected source values first.
Separate constructing a pipeline from requesting its next output.
Request at most k results, recording each delivered result, and stop before requesting another one.

questions.prompt: How many source values does the demo read to deliver two outputs?

choices.why: It reads 1, 3, 4 and 6, then stops before 9.
Reading the final 9 would exceed the requested prefix.
